# Current Objective

Fix Store B daily totals while preserving business-day and refund booking rules.

# Completed

- Confirmed A and C match; B has 16 mismatches whose paired deltas correspond to cutoff-adjacent transactions.

# Decisions

- The fault is report.timezones.parse_offset: negative offsets construct timedelta(hours=-3, minutes=30), which equals UTC-02:30, so B (-03:30) local timestamps are one hour late. Apply the sign to the entire offset in minutes; this preserves positive and whole-hour offsets.

# Next Suggested Step

Patch parse_offset, run check_report.py and focused conversion checks.

# Current Objective

Fix Store B daily totals while preserving business-day and refund booking rules.

# Completed

- Confirmed A and C match; B has 16 mismatches whose paired deltas correspond to cutoff-adjacent transactions.
- Patched negative fractional offset parsing and verified it eliminates 14 of 16 finance mismatches.
- Remaining B discrepancies equal replayed ledger entries exactly: six duplicate B2 receipts on 2026-09-17 total 97153 cents and three duplicate B1 receipts on 2026-09-23 total 49276 cents.
- Fixed negative fractional UTC offsets by applying the sign to the whole minute total.
- Ignored nine exact replayed till imports using the true till-transaction identity (store, terminal, receipt), while rejecting conflicting repeats.
- Verified check_report.py: all 84 store-days match finance; report package compiles.

# Decisions

- The fault is report.timezones.parse_offset: negative offsets construct timedelta(hours=-3, minutes=30), which equals UTC-02:30, so B (-03:30) local timestamps are one hour late. Apply the sign to the entire offset in minutes; this preserves positive and whole-hour offsets.
- Deduplicate imports by (store, terminal, receipt), because id is importer-assigned while each till owns its receipt numbering; receipt alone would be unsound across tills. Reject a repeated receipt that disagrees on business fields to avoid silently hiding inconsistent data.
- The identity scope includes terminal because each till numbers receipts independently; identical replays retain the first import-assigned ID and conflicting records fail loudly.

# Next Suggested Step

Review or commit the two report-code changes.
